messages:
maria.chen: quick async standup — SRE checks for the day. what i did: updated the payment-api SLO calc to include 5xx rate; rolled a small alert-suppression rule for noisy downstreams. blocker: seeing intermittent high kv-cache miss rate that spikes p50 latency. investigating.
alex.patel: thanks — can you drop the new SLO calc PR link? also did we set a burn-rate alert for the payments SLO? :eyes:
jordan.kim: PR is #1423, currently in review. i did the alert rule earlier: `slo.burn_rate > 3 for 5m` with annotation for runbook. raising because the threshold might be too tight for our traffic bursts.
priya.nair: oncall follow-up: last night's paging about `kv-cache-miss` came from eu-west-1. tagged infra team and created INC-458. oncall handled the page, turned out to be a GC pause on a node. i've added a postmortem note and a temp mitigation (auto-restart on >80% mem over 5m) until we patch.
maria.chen: thanks. Jordan — can you paste the PR link and the alert snippet? also add a comment to include an owner for runbook steps.
jordan.kim: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1423
alert snippet:
```
alert: PaymentsSLOBurnRateHigh
expr: rate(slo_burn_rate{service="payments"}[5m]) > 3
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  runbook: https://go.redwood/runbooks/payments-slo
```
alex.patel: quick note — the runbook link needs steps for fallback model routing and cache warmup. can you add that to the PR? also assign to @priya.nair as the recovery owner.
priya.nair: will do. i'll add the runbook recovery steps and the oncall play for eu-west. also scheduling a 30m retro with infra tomorrow 09:30 to discuss GC tuning and node sizing.
maria.chen: blocker update: i'm digging into the kv-cache miss patterns; seems tied to a new rollout we did last week (dedicated cache TTL change). rolling a canary back on a subset to validate.
alex.patel: FYI i'm going to finish the alert escalation matrix doc today and ping security for the KMS rotations note. aim to have that in the handbook by EOD.
oncall-bot: reminder: @priya.nair on-call this week (Mon-Fri). Pager duty shifts editable at https://oncall.redwood/schedule
deploy-bot: deploy infra-service v2.7.1 started by @jordan.kim — canary on 2 hosts in eu-west-1
maria.chen: action items:
- jordan: merge #1423 after adding runbook owner + fallback steps (EOD)
- priya: add postmortem bullet and schedule retro (tomorrow 09:30)
- alex: update escalation matrix in handbook (EOD)
- maria: roll back cache TTL canary and monitor kv-cache miss metric
any other quick blockers? :thumbsup:
